subtasks: Place the single orange disk fully onto the shortest, rightmost peg using the right gripper.
Stack both yellow squares onto the second peg from the right, beside the orange disk, with their holes around the peg.
Regrasp the tilted top yellow square on the third peg from the left, lift it clear, and reseat it flat on the lower yellow square with the peg through the hole.
Stack all three purple stars on the second peg from the left, directly to the left of the yellow squares. Insert each star's hole around this peg.

Stack all four loose blue rectangles on the tallest, leftmost peg immediately left of the purple stars. Fit each hole around that peg, release each rectangle flat, then open both grippers and return both arms to their starting poses.
